newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says Bre-X must reapply for COW.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says Bre-X must reapply for COW.

text.p: A senior Indonesian mining official said on Thursday Canada's Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp must jointly submit applications for contracts of work to develop the huge Busang gold find in Kalimantan.
Mines and Energy Ministry Secretary-General Umar Said told Reuters the application must be made through a joint venture that Bre-X and Barrick must set up to develop the find.
"Now that they have agreed to be partners in developing Busang, they must set up a joint venture company and make a fresh application for contracts of work," he said.
Umar said the application would go through the normal process of getting approvals from the director-general of mining, the Mines and Energy Minister, parliament and finally President Suharto.
"The government has stopped processing the previous application for contracts of work by Bre-X because of various problems," he said.
"Therefore the previous application by Bre-X that has been delayed must be stopped and must be said to have been cancelled," he said.

Umar said Bre-X and Barrick had agreed to the 25-75 percent split in Busang as recommended by the government, and that they would now have to set up a joint venture if they wanted to develop the find, estimated by Bre-X to contain at least 57 million ounces of gold.
